NB :We estimated a target audience participation of 75, with least target of 50. This estimation was based on a securing the stated venue within our Milestone 1—UPSA CAMPUS. This venue is closer to the central business district where so many businesses are located and therefore offers busineses the proximity to the event centre. However, due to a little delay in the release of fund we were unable to secure the funding to book the venue. Therefore we needed to relocate to another location which was quite far. Overall we registered 52 people, however only 30 people attended the event which was below our target. We've already communicated to the catalyst team about the challenge with securing our desired venue. Hopefully, in our subsequent events will to do better. I hope this helps
